**Permanent, cryptographically audited master vault of all PUBLIC Lean 4–verified research preprints, embedded build white papers, pure Lean 4 proof suites, architectural laws, pre-registered empirical claims, controlled discoveries, frozen PDFs, falsification dossiers, and pinned source repositories authored by Alexander Stephen Donahue (`Independent Researcher`).**

- **Author:** Alexander Stephen Donahue (`Alexander S. Donahue`) · **Independent Researcher**, Spokane, WA, USA
- **ORCID:** [`0009-0006-8168-9648`](https://orcid.org/0009-0006-8168-9648)
- **Contact:** `0_0@0thernes.art` · [0thernes.art](https://0thernes.art) · [github.com/0thernes](https://github.com/0thernes)
- **Scope:** **31 public research entries** across **3 explicitly separated epistemic tiers** + **20 pinned public Git submodules** (strictly excluding private/proprietary repositories and third-party forks).

---

## Non-Negotiable Verification & Epistemic Standards

1. **Kernel-Checked Proofs:** Formalized claims compile in Lean 4 with zero `sorry`, zero `admit`, zero custom axioms, and explicit `#print axioms` audits strictly within `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
2. **Independent Falsifiability:** Every Tier I & Tier II entry ships an explicit reproduction and falsification command so any third party can independently test every claim.
3. **Cryptographic Immutability:** Every frozen release PDF, Lean certificate, white paper, and discovery snapshot is hashed in [`CHECKSUMS.sha256`](CHECKSUMS.sha256), matched against pinned public Git submodules under `repos/`, and audited by GitHub Actions CI on every push.
4. **Honest Boundaries & Privacy Discipline:** Every dossier explicitly separates kernel-checked theorems, paper proofs, pre-registered empirical claims, finite computational certificates, exploratory syntheses, and open questions. Private repositories and third-party forks remain strictly excluded from this public archive.

---

## Quickstart

Clone the archive and run the full cryptographic & structural audit:

```bash
# Clone the archive (add --recursive to also fetch all 20 pinned PUBLIC submodules)
git clone --recursive https://github.com/0thernes/0thernes-research-archive.git
cd 0thernes-research-archive
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt

# Verify every SHA-256 digest, ORCID, axiom allowlist, and all 20 public submodule pins
python3 scripts/verify_archive.py
sha256sum -c CHECKSUMS.sha256
python3 -m pytest -v tests/
```

## Usage Examples

```bash
just reproduce   # Full clean verification + static portal + Build Standard v1.2.0 audit
just sync        # Deterministically regenerate all dossiers, markdown registries & SHA-256 manifests
just test        # Run integrity, Hypothesis property, negative, mutation & privacy-firewall tests
just audit       # Score repository against Build Standard v1.2.0
```

# Claims Ledger (`CLAIMS.md`)

| ID | Claim | Verification Tier | Evidence | What Would Prove Us Wrong |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **C1** | Every archived PDF, white paper, Lean certificate, metadata file, and discovery snapshot across all 31 entries (12 Tier I + 9 Tier II + 10 Tier III) matches its byte-exact SHA-256 digest in `CHECKSUMS.sha256`, `data/MANIFEST.sha256`, and `registry/*.json`. | **Cryptographic SHA-256 check** | `scripts/verify_archive.py`, `sha256sum -c CHECKSUMS.sha256`, `tests/test_archive_integrity.py` | Any SHA-256 mismatch, missing file, or unregistered PDF in `papers/`. |
| **C2** | Every pinned public Git submodule under `repos/` (`20` public repositories) matches the exact commit SHA recorded in `registry/PAPERS.json` and `registry/BUILD_PAPERS.json`. | **Exact Git index check** | `get_git_submodule_commits` in `scripts/verify_archive.py` | Any submodule drift between `git ls-files --stage repos` and `pinned_commit`. |
| **C3** | Every entry across all three tiers carries canonical ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`, an explicit `verification_boundary`, and Lean axiom allowlists strictly within `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`. | **Automated schema & policy check** | `scripts/verify_archive.py`, `tests/test_archive_integrity.py` | Any missing ORCID, missing verification boundary, or non-standard axiom in any allowlist. |
| **C4** | Zero private repositories or third-party forks are exposed anywhere in `registry/`, `repos/`, or `.gitmodules`. | **Automated visibility & privacy check** | `test_privacy_firewall_no_private_repos` in `tests/test_archive_integrity.py` | Any `visibility != "PUBLIC"` entry or any private repository slug appearing in public manifests. |

## What Would Prove Us Wrong (Falsification Protocol)

Any failing run of `python3 scripts/verify_archive.py`, `sha256sum -c CHECKSUMS.sha256`, or `python3 -m pytest -v tests/` immediately falsifies the corresponding integrity claim above. External critics can also independently clone any pinned submodule at its exact commit SHA and run the entry's `falsification_command` from `EVIDENCE.md`.

=== LIMITATIONS.md ===

# Limitations, Epistemic Boundaries & Real-vs-Metaphor (`LIMITATIONS.md`)

## 1. What This Master Archive Does and Does Not Guarantee

- **Cryptographic provenance, NOT external peer review:** `0thernes-research-archive` cryptographically locks frozen PDFs, exact Git submodule commits, Lean 4 axiom policies, and CI run links. None of the archived research preprints have undergone external journal peer review unless explicitly recorded with a publisher DOI.
- **No Mega-Atlas grand-problem retirement claimed:** As documented in [`builds/0TH-BUILD-007_unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/0THERNES_SOLVED_AUDIT_2026-11-25.md`](builds/0TH-BUILD-007_unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/0THERNES_SOLVED_AUDIT_2026-11-25.md), **0 of 1,900** grand open problems in `unsolved-problems-mega-atlas` are retired by entries in this archive; specialized theorems (such as Conjecture 7.7 of Banić & Elezović in `0TH-2026-006`) are proved within their exact cited scopes.
- **Historical snapshots vs. live repos:** Superseded repositories (`0TH-2026-001`, `002`, `003`, `005`) remain pinned as immutable historical snapshots for provenance while active unified research continues in `0TH-2026-009` (`pauli-contextuality-lab`). Historical `METADATA.json` records may retain earlier version metadata as frozen snapshots.
- **AI-assisted provenance:** Individual papers and builds were produced by solo researcher Alexander Stephen Donahue (`Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA`, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`) with disclosed AI assistance; epistemic trust rests on reproducible kernel verification and falsification commands in each entry's `EVIDENCE.md`.

## 2. Real vs. Metaphor

- **"Vault" / "Frozen":** Literally means committed Git blobs hashed with SHA-256 inside `CHECKSUMS.sha256` and verified on every push by GitHub Actions CI.
- **"Tier I / Tier II / Tier III":** Strict epistemic separation: Tier I holds standalone research preprints; Tier II holds engineering build white papers and embedded Pure Lean invariant suites; Tier III holds architectural laws, pre-registered empirical claims (including null results), finite computational certificates, and open-problem atlases—never conflated with Lean-proved general mathematical theorems.

=== REPLICATION.md ===

# Replication Protocol (`REPLICATION.md`)

Any third party can verify the entire master archive and independently reproduce any individual Tier I or Tier II entry from a clean clone:

```bash
# 1. Clone the archive (add --recursive to fetch all 20 pinned public submodules)
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/0thernes-research-archive.git
cd 0thernes-research-archive
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt

# 2. Verify every SHA-256 digest, ORCID, axiom policy, README sync, and submodule pin
python3 scripts/verify_archive.py
sha256sum -c CHECKSUMS.sha256

# 3. Run automated integrity, property, negative, and mutation tests
python3 -m pytest -v tests/
bash scripts/audit-repo.sh .
```

To verify a specific paper's Lean 4 formal proof from scratch, run `git submodule update --init repos/<slug>` and execute the exact `falsification_command` printed in `papers/<id>/EVIDENCE.md`.

=== docs/architecture.md ===

# Archive Architecture (`docs/architecture.md`)

`0thernes-research-archive` organizes all public scientific outputs authored by Alexander Stephen Donahue (`ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648`) into **three strictly separated epistemic tiers**, backed by **20 pinned public Git submodules** under `repos/` and a unified SHA-256 integrity manifest (`CHECKSUMS.sha256` & `data/MANIFEST.sha256`).

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    R1["registry/PAPERS.json<br/>Tier I: 12 Standalone Preprints"] --> V["scripts/verify_archive.py"]
    R2["registry/BUILD_PAPERS.json<br/>Tier II: 9 Public Build Papers & Lean Suites"] --> V
    R3["registry/LAWS_AND_DISCOVERIES.json<br/>Tier III: 10 Public Laws, Claims & Atlases"] --> V
    S["repos/* (20 Pinned Public Submodules)"] --> V
    V --> C["CHECKSUMS.sha256 & data/MANIFEST.sha256"]
    V --> D["Per-Entry METADATA.json + EVIDENCE.md"]
    V --> P["scripts/build_site.py -> GitHub Pages Portal"]
```

## Verification Invariants

1. **Single-script deterministic derivation (`scripts/verify_archive.py --sync`):** Regenerates all `METADATA.json`, `EVIDENCE.md`, `registry/*.md`, and `CHECKSUMS.sha256` directly from the three canonical JSON registries.
2. **Exact submodule commit pinning:** Every `pinned_commit` in `PAPERS.json` and `BUILD_PAPERS.json` is cross-checked against `git ls-files --stage repos`.
3. **Strict axiom & ORCID enforcement:** Every entry must carry ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`, an explicit `verification_boundary`, and Lean axiom allowlists strictly within `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
4. **Public-only privacy firewall:** Zero private repositories or third-party forks may appear in `registry/` or `.gitmodules`.

---

=== docs/threat-model.md ===

# Threat Model (`docs/threat-model.md`)

| Threat ID | Threat | Impact | Mitigations |
|---|---|---|---|
| **T1** | **Artifact tampering / silent PDF substitution** | Frozen paper differs from verified release | Byte-exact SHA-256 verification on every push in `scripts/verify_archive.py`, `sha256sum -c CHECKSUMS.sha256`, and `data/MANIFEST.sha256`; SLSA attestations on releases. |
| **T2** | **Submodule drift** (registry claims commit X while `repos/` points to commit Y) | Reproduction tests wrong source tree | `get_git_submodule_commits` cross-checks `git ls-files --stage repos` against every `pinned_commit` in CI. |
| **T3** | **Privacy-firewall leakage** (accidental inclusion of a private repository in public vault) | Exposure of private/proprietary paths or slugs | Automated visibility enforcement (`visibility == "PUBLIC"`) and private-slug guard in `tests/test_archive_integrity.py`. |
| **T4** | **Epistemic tier conflation** (presenting empirical/exploratory Tier III items as Lean-proved Tier I theorems) | Misleading scientific claims | Three physically separated JSON/MD registries with mandatory `verification_boundary` fields checked in CI. |
| **T5** | **Secret leakage or CI compromise** | Credential exposure | `gitleaks` report-only scan in `.github/workflows/archive-audit.yml`; minimal `contents: read` permissions on CI jobs. |

---

=== docs/operations.md ===

# Operations, Backups & Offsite Mirror (`docs/operations.md`)

## 1. Syncing & Verifying Cryptographic Digests

After updating any archived PDF, artifact, or pinned submodule commit:

```bash
python3 scripts/verify_archive.py --sync
cp CHECKSUMS.sha256 data/MANIFEST.sha256
sha256sum -c CHECKSUMS.sha256
python3 -m pytest -v tests/
```

## 2. Creating an Offline Git Bundle Backup

Create a self-contained single-file backup of all archive metadata, frozen PDFs, and submodule pin pointers:

```bash
git bundle create 0thernes-research-archive-$(cat VERSION).bundle --all
git bundle verify 0thernes-research-archive-$(cat VERSION).bundle
sha256sum 0thernes-research-archive-$(cat VERSION).bundle
```

## 3. Offsite Mirrors & Long-Term Preservation

- **GitHub Releases (`release.yml`):** Every `v*` tag publishes all three JSON registries, `CHECKSUMS.sha256`, `SHA256SUMS`, and Sigstore SLSA build-provenance attestations (`actions/attest-build-provenance@v2`).
- **Software Heritage & Zenodo:** Archive snapshots and individual paper repositories are preserved independently of GitHub via Software Heritage (`Save Code Now`) and Zenodo DOIs (e.g., `10.5281/zenodo.24517198` on `0TH-2026-010`).
- **Secondary Git remote mirror:** `git remote add mirror <url> && git push --mirror mirror`.

=== docs/faq.md ===

# Frequently Asked Questions (`docs/faq.md`)

### 1. Why are entries split into Tier I, Tier II, and Tier III?
To enforce epistemic honesty: Tier I holds standalone formalized research preprints (`PAPERS.json`), Tier II holds public software/engineering builds with embedded white papers and Pure Lean 4 invariant suites (`BUILD_PAPERS.json`), and Tier III holds architectural laws, pre-registered empirical claims (including null results), finite certificates, and open-problem atlases (`LAWS_AND_DISCOVERIES.json`).

### 2. Have any papers in this archive retired one of the 1,900 Mega-Atlas problems?
**No (`0 / 1,900` grand Mega-Atlas problems retired).** Specialized open conjectures such as Conjecture 7.7 of Banić & Elezović (`0TH-2026-006`) and Jonah's Conjecture E (`0TH-2026-009`) are formally proved in Lean 4 within their exact published scopes; see [`builds/0TH-BUILD-007_unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/0THERNES_SOLVED_AUDIT_2026-11-25.md`](../builds/0TH-BUILD-007_unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/0THERNES_SOLVED_AUDIT_2026-11-25.md).

### 3. How do I verify every archived PDF and submodule pin locally?
Run `python3 scripts/verify_archive.py` and `sha256sum -c CHECKSUMS.sha256`. Every hash and Git submodule pin is verified in under 2 seconds.

=== docs/glossary.md ===

# Glossary (`docs/glossary.md`)

- **Tier I (`PAPERS.json`):** Standalone research preprints with frozen PDFs, Lean 4 formal proofs, and falsification commands.
- **Tier II (`BUILD_PAPERS.json`):** Public engineering builds shipping embedded white papers and Pure Lean 4.35.0 invariant suites.
- **Tier III (`LAWS_AND_DISCOVERIES.json`):** Public architectural laws, pre-registered empirical falsification ledgers, finite certificates, and open-problem atlases.
- **Pinned Git Submodule:** Exact 40-character Git commit SHA under `repos/` verified against `registry/*.json` via `git ls-files --stage repos`.
- **Ten Finding Classes (Build Standard `R7`):** `bug`, `error`, `issue`, `problem`, `concern`, `dilemma`, `conflict`, `gap`, `hole`, `blindspot` (see `.github/labels.tsv` for concise definitions).
